sentences.text: The Royal Commission into Defence and Veteran Suicide was asked to identify systemic problems and propose ways to prevent suicide and suicidality among current and former ADF members.

sentences.text: It examined cultural, structural and systemic issues across the ADF, Defence and the Department of Veterans’ Affairs.

sentences.text: The Commission found that institutional problems in Defence and the Department of Veterans’ Affairs contributed to persistently high levels of suicide and suicidality.
